variantsConverted.to: typed props on List/Trigger/Content/Link + inline SVG chevron

propsInvented.name: viewport (Root)
propsInvented.why: Upstream boolean; kept. Controls shared viewport + data-viewport skin branch.

propsInvented.name: wrap (List)
propsInvented.why: Demo uses class="flex-wrap". No class merge.

propsInvented.name: variant / icon (Trigger)
propsInvented.why: Muted open tone and custom/hidden chevron without IconPlaceholder or class strings.

propsInvented.name: layout / width (Content)
propsInvented.why: Source demos size/layout panels with Tailwind grid + arbitrary widths on nested ul.

propsInvented.name: variant (Link)
propsInvented.why: Top-level links use triggerStyle(); panel/hero links use one-off layout classes.

deviations.what: Docs Preview/Examples use overflow="visible" + tall min-height wrappers
deviations.why: .doc-preview defaults to overflow:hidden which clips absolute viewport/content panels
deviations.risk: low — consumers outside docs have no clip; only docs chrome needed the escape hatch

deviations.what: viewport=false content is always position:absolute (source is md:absolute)
deviations.why: Without absolute, top:100% does nothing and the popover skin cannot float under the item on small screens

deviations.what: Separate enter/exit keyframes for viewport motion vs popover scale
deviations.why: Oracle applies scale only when data-viewport=false; motion uses translate/opacity
bits-ui NavigationMenu uses Viewport + Content, not a separate positioner/popup API in this version
